angularDiameterSource: Limb-darkened angular diameter 0.736 +/- 0.015 (statistical) +/- 0.012 (systematic) mas, VLTI/VINCI in the K band, Di Folco et al. (2004, A&A 426, 601; doi:10.1051/0004-6361:20047189), Table 3; the star is only 14% resolved, the least resolved of their five stars.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 50.9307 +/- 0.1482 mas (same row; RUWE 3.07, the star is bright for Gaia): 1000/50.930690628822894 = 19.6345 pc, no zero-point correction. Lacour et al. (2021) fitted their orbits at the Gaia DR2 parallax 51.44 +/- 0.12 mas; the hosted orbits keep their angular sizes and are placed at this distance.
radiusSource: Radius: the VLTI/VINCI limb-darkened angular diameter 0.736 +/- 0.015 (statistical) +/- 0.012 (systematic) mas of Di Folco et al. (2004, A&A 426, 601, Table 3) at the Gaia DR3 distance 19.6345 pc: 1,080,920 km, 1.5537 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (Zwintz et al. 2019 derive 1.538 +/- 0.040 from the same diameter at the Hipparcos parallax; their seismic model gives 1.497 +/- 0.025). GM from the dynamical stellar mass 1.75 +/- 0.03 solar masses of Lacour et al. (2021, A&A 654, L2, Table 2, RV + b and c astrometry) times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; the star's spin axis is aligned with the disc and the planets' orbits to 3 +/- 4 degrees on the sky (Kraus et al. 2020) but its period is not adopted here.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 8090 +/- 59 K from Zwintz et al. 2019 (A&A 627, A28; https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.12545), Table 4, their seismic model fit; the average of earlier spectroscopic determinations they list is 8143 +/- 67 K
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Pic (pscomppars): spectral type A6 V, from Sutlieff et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..10S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * bet Pic: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Pic (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.21 dex, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Pic (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.95282, from Wang et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...97W/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Pic (pscomppars): age 0.023 Gyr, from Sutlieff et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1006L..10S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of bet Pic (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 116.41 km/s, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json), because no image of the photosphere exists (see investigations.json). A star's limb is not a sharp surface.

surfaceGravitySource: log g from the dynamical mass 1.75 +/- 0.03 solar masses of Lacour et al. (2021, A&A 654, L2, Table 2) and the package radius, log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.30 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot gives 4.21).
